# Splunk dev toolchain for the loop-smoke CI gate.
#
# POLICY: always build and test against the LATEST ucc-gen / AppInspect, everywhere the
# toolchain is used. These were previously hard-pinned (==6.5.1 / ==4.2.1) so the
# deterministic no-LLM loop-smoke gate could not be flipped red by an unrelated upstream
# release. That pin is deliberately gone: we would rather find out on the day a new release
# changes generated files or check outcomes than ship a package built against a stale
# toolchain. Every other CI job (splunk-app, splunk-integration, licenses) already floated.
#
# Consequence to expect: a ucc-gen / AppInspect release CAN turn loop-smoke red without any
# code change here. That is a real signal about the newest release, not CI flakiness - read
# the diff in the generated output before assuming it is noise.
#
# The floors below are compatibility minimums (Splunk 10 / ucc-gen 6.5), not pins.
splunk-add-on-ucc-framework>=6.5.0
splunk-appinspect>=4.3.0
